summary: Iteration 6 (Custom Stages + Portfolio ROI + Measurement Reminders + phase_counts/stages in analytics) tested end-to-end on <preview-host> Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py with 17 pytest cases across 6 test classes — all 17 PASSED. Frontend: logged in as platform admin on Northwind workspace and verified: (a) Settings → Pipeline stages editor (data-testid stage-editor) with 8 default rows, rename/add/gate-toggle/reorder work, Save shows toast 'Pipeline stages saved. The board and inventory now use them.' and the new 'teststagex' row is persisted (verified via GET /organizations/o-northwind/stages after save); (b) Pipeline board renders 8 columns pipeline-col-{key} and 25 cards pipeline-card-{id}, each card shows area label (Strategy & Leadership…), Phase pill (Phase 1), owner warning ⚠ for no-owner records, and gated ⬥ markers on Approved/In progress/Live/Realized; area filter pipeline-area-filter narrows 25→1 for 'strategy'; selecting Approved on opp-nw-2 raises error toast exactly 'Assign an owner before moving to “Approved”. Gated stages need an accountable owner.' (c) Dashboard: reminders-banner reads '1 measurement checkpoint due — record realized benefit on records that are now 3 / 6 / 12 months past Live.'; widget-roi_by_area, widget-phase_progress and widget-reminders render; Arrange (dash-edit-btn) opens dash-add-widget with 9 items including add-widget-roi_by_area, add-widget-phase_progress, add-widget-reminders; shared filter-stage=discovery changes '37 of 37 records' → '3 of 37 records'; dash-save-btn and dash-publish-default present. (d) Workspace switcher → ws-ws-meridian → nav-oversight → pf-pf-a renders portfolio-roi table with rows portfolio-roi-o-vertex and portfolio-roi-o-harbor (dedupe confirmed), area color dots and function-family legend visible, aggregation methodology notes shown. Stages restored to defaults at end of UI run (verified GET).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `get_stages` returns `is_custom: stages is not DEFAULT_STAGES`, but once an admin saves identical defaults the stored list is a different object → is_custom will always be True after first save. Low priority — only affects a UI badge, not behavior.
measurement_reminders uses `datetime.fromisoformat` on `went_live_at` and silently skips invalid values; consider logging to detect bad seed/mutations rather than hiding reminders.

`_blocked_reason` only enforces 'owner required for gated' — if business later adds other gating criteria (e.g., evidence present for 'realized'), extend here rather than in both move_stage and bulk_action.
`portfolio_analytics._org_rollup` fetches each org serially (`for oid in visible`) with multiple awaits per org; for larger portfolios consider asyncio.gather for parallel aggregation.
Settings page is a single 156-line file but StageEditor is already a sub-component. Fine as-is; no refactor needed.

Frontend: `page.goto('/settings')` from an unauthenticated or freshly-loaded context redirects to '/'. Using the sidebar nav-settings link works. Not a bug but worth noting SPA deep-link to /settings served the root page in my test — may be a react-router basename or ingress rewrite subtlety.
test_credentials: from env: ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD / DEMO_USERS_PASSWORD (values never stored in the repo)
seed_data_creation: No net new seed. Side effects of tests, all reverted: (a) backend tests mutate init-nw-1 area to 'sales' via bulk — harmless; (b) opp-nw-2 owner briefly cleared then restored path exercised; (c) stages for o-northwind were edited (rename+add+gate+reorder) and restored by the module-scoped fixture AND by the UI restore step. Final GET /organizations/o-northwind/stages confirms 8 defaults with the original gated set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 verified end-to-end. Reusable regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py covers Custom Stages (default/put/duplicate/removal-with-records/viewer-403), stage-move (gated no-owner block, unknown-stage), Portfolio ROI (/portfolios/pf-a/analytics shape+dedupe+viewer-403), Reminders (presence of Sales Co-Pilot m6 + viewer-403 on other orgs), analytics phase_counts+stages, and dashboard+isolation+bulk regression. Previous iteration file /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_lifecycle.py still passes (17 tests). rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 17 backend tests and all 4 UI flows (Settings/Pipeline/Dashboard/Oversight) passed on first full run.
